_comment: Speed limit overrides, per zone, in KILOMETRES PER HOUR.
This file is for EXCEPTIONS ONLY and ships nearly empty on purpose. Limits are normally
derived from two things the game already knows -- whether a road is on the arterial
network, and whether the district is policed by a city force -- which between them cover
the map without anybody hand-filling ninety-seven zones.
A growing list here is a sign the derivation needs fixing rather than papering over. The
entries below are places where it is genuinely wrong: somewhere with tarmac wide enough to
read as a main road that nobody is meant to drive quickly on.
Zone codes are the game's own, as GET_NAME_OF_ZONE returns them. See stations.json for the
same convention. An unknown code is ignored, so a typo costs that one entry.
